join.title: Join
join.subtitle: Use the QR code on your pupil card, or enter the room code and your personal student code.

account.title: Join with an account
account.help: Use the room code from your teacher. Sign in with the email address your teacher invited.

studentCode.label: Personal student code
studentCode.tip: Forgot your code? Ask your teacher or co-teacher.

status.checkingExisting: Checking whether this device is already joined…

codeChanged.title: Your student code has changed
codeChanged.body: Use the room code and the new personal student code from your teacher. You'll find your saved work when you return.

errors.schoolPupilAccountRequired: This student uses an account in this room. Choose “Join with an account” and sign in with the address your teacher invited.
errors.accountTransferConflict: This account already has a different student registration in the room. Ask your teacher to check which registration should be used.
errors.accountTransferUnavailable: The link to the pupil card is no longer available. Ask your teacher to check the invitation.
errors.schoolProviderDisabled: Your school does not allow this sign-in method.
errors.schoolProviderMethods: Your school allows {methods}. Switch sign-in method and try again.
errors.switchSignInFailed: Could not switch how you sign in. Try again.
errors.schoolPupilCodeDisabled: This school requires a student account. Choose “Join with an account” and use the invited email address and room code.
errors.accountRequired: Sign in with a student account to join.
errors.accountRoleIneligible: This account's role blocks student access. Switch accounts, or ask for help if this is the account you should use.
errors.accountProfileIncomplete: Complete your student profile to join. The room code will be filled in when you return here.
errors.accountEmailUnverified: Open the verification link in your email. Return here and select “Join”.
errors.accountInvitationRequired: There is no valid invitation for this account. Check the email address above or ask your teacher to check the invitation.
errors.studentCodeAttempts: Too many code attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.spaceNotFound: We couldn't find that room code. Check the code from your teacher or open the room link again.
errors.authTimeout: Timed out while waiting for auth user.
errors.studentCodeRequired: This room requires a personal student code. Use the student link or student code from your teacher.
errors.invalidStudentCode: Check that you entered the correct room code and your personal student code. Ask your teacher or co-teacher if the codes still don't work.
errors.teacherLimitReached: This teacher has reached the student limit for the current plan.
errors.missingSpaceId: Join succeeded, but no spaceId was returned.
errors.identityConflict: This pupil code has conflicting records. Ask your teacher for help.
errors.missingPupilName: Your teacher must register a name before this code can be used.
errors.accessRevoked: This access has been revoked. Contact your teacher.
errors.roomUnavailable: This room is archived and cannot be opened with a pupil code.
errors.managerAccount: This sign-in manages the space. Sign out or use another browser profile to request student access.
errors.requestChanged: The request has already been processed or changed. Check access again.

confirmation.switch: This browser is currently using {name}. Continue to change pupil.
confirmation.signOut: You will be signed out of this account in this browser and continue as a guest with the personal pupil code.

session.confirm: The next pupil must use their own code. Forgotten your student code? Ask your teacher. Answers and room access are kept.
session.logoutConfirm: You will be signed out of this browser. Your answers are kept. The next pupil must use their own pupil code or link.
session.signedOut: You are signed out. The next pupil can use their own pupil code or link. Forgotten your pupil code? Ask your teacher.
session.endFailed: Could not end the session. Please try again.

approval.title: Your teacher must approve access
approval.description: Send a request before this sign-in can be used for the participant. Existing work is preserved.
approval.waiting: Show the confirmation code to your teacher. You can continue after approval.
approval.expired: This request has expired. Send a new request and show the new code to your teacher.
approval.rejected: Your teacher rejected the request. Talk to your teacher before sending a new one.
approval.cancelled: The request was cancelled. You can send a new one when ready.
approval.replace: Another request exists for this sign-in. Send a new request for the code you have now selected.
